account.title: Account Settings
account.profileEmailNote: Email address changes are managed through your identity provider.
account.workspaceLeaveDesc: You will lose access to all shared experiments and reports in this workspace.
account.workspaceLeaveConfirm: Are you sure you want to leave this workspace?
account.dangerDeleteDesc: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
account.dangerDeleteDescSoleOrgMember: You are the only member of the {org} workspace. Deleting your account will also permanently delete that workspace and all its data.
account.dangerDeleteDescOrgAdmin: You are an admin of the {org} workspace. Deleting your account will remove you from it. If you are the only admin, you must promote another member to admin first.
account.dangerDeleteNotAllowed: Account deletion is not available. Contact support if you believe this is an error.
account.dangerDeleteFailed: Failed to delete account. If you are the sole admin of a workspace with other members, please promote another member to admin first.
